connector.name: Cloudinary Asset Management by subomi
connector.registryDescription: Upload, organize, search, and transform images, videos, and files with AI-powered tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sample-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.

connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
